The domain margin was never a margin -- 26 strata of one or two episodes, where clearing -0.10 needs at least ten -- and is renamed domain_zero_loss for the rule it arithmetically is, with the evaluator raising if the two predicates ever disagree; it holds under all four readings. The leakage guard was fail-open on a missing key and blind to pair role, and is now three-valued with a __bool__ that raises rather than picking a polarity.

What the repair exposed is a new and separate blocker, and it is the one that now holds P1-U-T1: the frozen core builds problem_id as p1-r6-root:{episode_id}, and episode ids are R5-<QUERY>-A/-C/-U, so the pair role crosses the provider boundary on all 48 episodes and both arms. One thing the probe did establish is worth carrying into that corpus: it must contain partially observed pairs. Every existing atlas observes each coordinate on both sides or neither, which is why the over-resolution guard ran with a zero denominator, and a new corpus built the same way would inherit the same blind spot.

blockers.statement: Part of the primitive semantics is now defined independently of the theorem and machine-checked: local mechanics, their declared frames, and the separation result hold for any number of coordinates over any value domain and for every transformer obeying its frame, with the converse proved so separation is the boundary rather than one sufficient condition among others (P6_SEPARATION_CALCULUS_MECHANIZED_2026-08-21). What remains unlifted is the other half: the reopening and restoration semantics behind the 155 restorations and 1,055 strict-subset failures are still exhaustive enumeration over a four-node authored space.

Dependency reachability over a DAG is the same shape as the conversion closure already mechanized for P8, including the well-founded rank that makes the closure least -- without that rank a first-order axiomatisation admits reach facts that justify each other in a cycle, which is a defect that cost a real countermodel to find. Then state minimality as the claim that the reopened set is the least set closed under dependency containing the changed nodes, and conservativity as the claim that reopening nothing changes nothing, and discharge both against the same primitives.

blockers.statement: A general composition and revocation theorem now exists for P8's formal core and is machine-checked over uninterpreted sorts, so it is not a finite instance (P8_AUTHORITY_CALCULUS_MECHANIZED_2026-08-21). What is still absent is the link from that core to the 13-donor composition model whose 169/169 valid chains this terminal names: the theorems govern the authorisation rule, not the donor-type semantics, and no proof connects the two.
blockers.unblock: Two steps remain, both formal. Define the 13 donor types as an interpretation of the proved primitives -- each donor's discharge semantics as a conversion relation and an obligation set over the same signature -- and prove that interpretation sound, so the donor model becomes a model of the calculus rather than a parallel construction. Then P8-U-T2's instance derivation follows from the same interpretation. Two known limits travel with the artifact and should not be lost: reachability is axiomatised as a reflexive-transitive closure with a well-founded rank because transitive closure is not first-order definable, and the chain theorem's induction schema is the single hand step, with the step itself machine-checked and the expanded form discharged separately at every length up to eight.
